notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Atsushi to die.
description:
Kill Atsushi.
Atsushi triggers, creating three Food tokens, three Clue tokens and three Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all tokens you control to become a copy of the Myr.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, causing you to create a token of the card Mechanized Production is attached to and causing you to win the game.
